rb_le_job_aid_worker = {
	any_owned_colony = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				num_assigned_jobs = {
					job = aid_worker
					value > 0
				}
				free_jobs_of_type = {
					job = aid_worker
					include_deprioritized_jobs = yes
					value > 0
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							is_gestalt = no
						}
					}
					rb_le_can_build_holding_aid_agency = yes
				}
			}
			any_owned_pop_group = {
				can_work_specific_job = aid_worker
			}
		}
	}
}

							AND = {

									is_gestalt = no

					}
					AND = {

								}

									value > 0

									is_regular_empire = yes
									has_active_tradition = tr_mercantile_commercial_enterprise

rb_le_job_transference_volunteer = {
	any_owned_colony = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				num_assigned_jobs = {
					job = transference_volunteer
					value > 0
				}
				free_jobs_of_type = {
					job = transference_volunteer
					include_deprioritized_jobs = yes
					value > 0
				}
				AND = {
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							is_regular_empire = yes
						}
					}
					rb_le_can_build_district_mindlink = yes
				}
			}
			any_owned_pop_group = {
				can_work_specific_job = transference_volunteer
			}
		}
	}
}

rb_le_job_treasure_gatherer = {
	any_owned_colony = {
		AND = {
			AND = {
				AND = {
					has_deposit = d_treasure_planet
					AND = {
						exists = owner
						owner = {
							has_origin = origin_treasure_hunters
							is_gestalt = no
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					num_assigned_jobs = {
						job = treasure_gatherer
						value > 0
					}
					free_jobs_of_type = {
						job = treasure_gatherer
						include_deprioritized_jobs = yes
						value > 0
					}
				}
			}
			any_owned_pop_group = {
				can_work_specific_job = treasure_gatherer
			}
		}
	}
}
